## Pass 1: units.json

1. 3094–3096 · n · error. Pidal's note to 3094 was quoted with *"escarí"*; the print has *"escari"* (no accent, zoom 6).
   Fixed in the Spanish and in the English.
2. 3121–3122 · n · error. The Cervantes quotation in Pidal's note to 3121 was given as *Ruidíaz*; the print has
   *Ruidiaz* (zoom 5; *merecía* does carry its accent). Fixed.
3. 3097–3098 · n · weak. The reference "(p. 119, n.)" was left as "119 with a subscript 19 or 10, … not quite clear". At
   zoom 6 it is 119 with subscript 19, and PDF p. 123 (printed 119) settles it: it is Pidal's prose reconstruction of the
   lost opening, line 19 is the Çid plucking García Ordóñez's beard at Cabra, and the note to line 19 says that plucking
   a man's beard was a common affront punished by the laws. The note now says this.
4. 3073–3074 · n · weak. "Velmezes, v. p. 105" was explained as "an earlier note of his". The poem begins on printed p.
   123 (source/tiradas.json), so p. 105 is his introduction. Corrected.
5. 3087–3089 · l, n · weak. `l` "for he himself it ordered" made *se* reflexive; the note said "what se stands for here is
   not clear". *se lo* is the ordinary dative *se* (= le, old *gelo*) before *lo*. `l` now "for he to-them it ordered"; the
   note says the persons ordered (presumably the makers) go unsaid, the reading still uncertain as Pidal marks it.
6. 3075–3077 · l · weak. *dulçes* "smooth" in `l` was neither the literal word nor the note's reading; `l` now "sweet"
   (the note gives 'literally sweet', taken as 'fine-tempered'; `i` unchanged).
7. 3087–3089 · n · style. "the comma in his note stands inside the quote mark" misdescribed the print, which is
   *'tela de hilo',' v. 183* (closing quote, comma, a stray second quote). The note now says so.
8. 3080–3081 · n · style. *buscaren* "(as in the law-books: 'if they seek')": an unsupported aside. Now "future
   subjunctive in the if-clause".
9. 3097–3098 · n · style. "prísola = prísola: priso …" (tautology) → "prísola = priso + la".
10. 3097–3098 · n · style. Hinard's French as quoted by Pidal reads *parece qu'il* (zoom 5, so printed): added "(parece
    in the French is so printed, for parce)".
11. 3060, 3079, 3109, 3114b, 3118 · l · style. Letter-level restorations were bracketed in `l` (*dawn[s]*, *w[a]s*,
    *m[y]*, *co[u]nt*, *to-s[it]*, *si[t]*), against the published parts (01-04 *ve[e]r* "to-see", 134-136 *co[m]de*
    "count", *f[o]* "was", 132-133 *mi[e] cort* "my court") and inconsistent within this part (*ve[er]* "to-see"). Now
    plain; word-level restorations and names (*Jero[me]*, *Vermu[doz]*, *Albar[oz]*) keep their brackets, as published.
12. 3114 · n · style. Pidal's paragraph indent at 3114 (seen by the drafter, said in the notes for 3084, 3101, 3104
    only) added to the note.
13. 3123–3125 · i · style. "he looks every inch a man": a stock English idiom beyond *bien semeja varón*; rebuilt "he
    looks a true man indeed".

## Pass 2: gloss.json

1. nació · error. The example was "en buen ora nació 'born in a good hour', the poem's formula": the line is *que en
   buen punto nació*, said of Martín Muñoz. Rewritten from the text and the unit.
2. __broaden__ que · error. The new sense parsed *esto que recabdar quiere* as 'that which he wishes to bring about';
   the line is *por tal lo faze esto que …* 'for this reason, that' (already in the known entry), object *todo lo s[o]*.
   The broaden now gives only *aver que* + infinitive (*abrien que ve[er]*).
3. levantar · weak. "Pidal's text has no reflexive pronoun after nos = non se" contradicted itself; now "the reflexive se
   carried in Nos = non + se".
4. garçiez · weak. "modern Garcés/Garcíaz" (Garcíaz is invented) and no house name; now 'Galín García' (house), the same
   knight as Galind Garçiaz / Galín Garcia[z].
5. dulçes · weak. Example "'smooth, keen swords'" against the unit; now 'literally sweet', 'fine-tempered', our reading.
6. velmezes · weak. "his p. 105 note" and "no modern word, closest gambesón/jubón acolchado" (not from Pidal); now p. 105
   of his introduction, = velmez (archaic).
7. __broaden__ anda · weak. "probably 'Bad-walker'" invented; now 'a man's name', literally 'goes badly', with Pidal's note
   to 3070 (a real person, one of the *sabidores*).
8. __broaden__ recabdar · weak (added). The known 'to carry out, see to' does not cover 'secure' or Pidal's two senses
   (note to 3098).
9. __broaden__ cubrió · weak (added). 'he covered' does not cover *cubrió un manto* 'put on' (Pidal's note to 3099).
10. __broaden__ seed · weak (added). The known 'be! (= sed)' does not cover *se[e]d* 'sit!' (seer < sedere), the unit's
    reading.
11. __broaden__ se · weak (added). The dative *se* (= le) of *se lo mandó*, as the unit now reads it.
12. __broaden__ sabidor · style (added). 'learned in the law' (v. 3005, Pidal 'peritos en derecho'), the unit's reading.
13. contalassen · style. Lemma was the inflected form; now *contalar (?)*, with Pidal's 'arrancárselos' as 'pull out'.
14. prima · style. "the second office of the day" (invented count) → 'the office of the first hour of the day'.
15. faza · style. "a form of faza/fazia, Latin facie ad" dropped; f- for h- said.
16. cordones · style. "or that hold the beard" (that is *cordón*, singular, v. 3097) dropped.
17. desobra · style. "closest demasía, agravio": *agravio* not Pidal's; now = demasía, desmán, with his note quoted.
18. buscaren · style. "archaic/legal": 'legal' dropped.
19. __broaden__ so · style. Trailing "also so + los" (meaningless) dropped.
20. __broaden__ sazón · style. Added that *a sazón* is Pidal's restoration.
21. __broaden__ mal · style. "nickname … uncertain" → 'a man's name (see anda)'.

The other broadens (*primo*, *vestidos*, *sobrellas*, *ala*, *presas*, *posó*, *posan*, *assí*, *razón*, *ondra*,
*sabor*) are needed and correct. Every broaden begins with the known entry exactly as in known-forms.json + " · "
(verified by script, 21 now). gloss.json parses; its keys equal the 42 novel-form tokens plus `__broaden__`. The other
novel entries (suelta, ofrenda, cúnplansse, sufrir, armiños, presos, derechos, tovier, respondieron, camas, çapatos,
huebra, vistió, camisa, puño, çiclatón, bandas, viste, escarín, obrada, prísola, cordón, abrien, lla, cuerdamientra,
elos, âlgunos, merçedes, torniño, aguisamientos, vergüença) were checked against the form, the units and Pidal's notes
and found right.

## Refused

- 3063 `i` "my best right arm": *right* is not in *braço*, but "right arm" is the natural English for a chief helper and
  the note gives 'my best arm'. Kept.
- 3062 `i` "a rich one" for *muy buena*: a slight colouring of 'very good' toward the offering's value; within the
  register. Kept.
- 3086 note "huebra … from Latin opera": not Pidal's, but plain etymology, not a claim about the text. Kept.
- 3091 `l` *pareçen* "they-shine": Pidal's Bello 'relumbran' is quoted; the `l` follows the note's reading. Kept.
- No broaden for *pareçen* ('look, appear' covers), *cofia* (the coif under mail covers a coif), *presa* of 3124 (the
  participle is in the known entry), *desí* (covers *desí adelant*), *pro* (*de pro* covered).

## Left uncertain

- 3094 *pro* followed by a damaged mark: read as comma (sense runs on).
- 3088 *presa* 'presilla' (?) and 3089 *ca él se lo mandó* (?): Pidal's own queries; the units say so.
- 3080 *desobra*, 3096 *contalassen* (Pidal: unknown words), 3098 *recabdar* (two senses), 3062 *[a sazón]*, 3061
  *suelta*, 3077 *dulçes*, 3095 *fecha por razón*: our readings, flagged in the notes.
- 3063 *mejor.* and 3107 *naçió.*: full stops mid-sentence as printed, kept.
